name: lumi-prod-plugin
description: Connect Codex to Lumi Desktop projects through local MCP OAuth.

interface.shortDescription: Read and edit an authorized local Lumi project.
interface.longDescription: Connect through local HTTP OAuth, choose one project and permission in Lumi, then use shared API documentation and project tools. Lumi must be running.
defaultPrompt: Inspect my authorized Lumi project and suggest the next step.
